comment.text: MYO18A G979 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting MYO18A residue G979 have been observed in adrenocortical carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.
